mapper.sql: id, english_name, anime_title, role_type AS archetype, energy AS element, image_url, tags AS quote, popularity_score AS popularity, enabled

where.if: english_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR anime_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_Draw_lots_character (english_name, anime_title, role_type, energy, image_url, tags, popularity_score, enabled) VALUES (#{englishName}, #{animeTitle}, #{archetype}, #{element}, #{imageUrl}, #{quote}, #{popularity}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_Draw_lots_character SET english_name = #{englishName}, anime_title = #{animeTitle}, role_type = #{archetype}, energy = #{element}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, tags = #{quote}, popularity_score = #{popularity}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sekai_Draw_lots_fortune ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_Draw_lots_fortune (level_name, score_min, score_max, lucky_color, lucky_item, summary, advice, enabled) VALUES (#{levelName}, #{scoreMin}, #{scoreMax}, #{luckyColor}, #{luckyItem}, #{summary}, #{advice}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_Draw_lots_fortune SET level_name = #{levelName}, score_min = #{scoreMin}, score_max = #{scoreMax}, lucky_color = #{luckyColor}, lucky_item = #{luckyItem}, summary = #{summary}, advice = #{advice}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
